title: Koch-Tataru theorem for 3D incompressible active nematic liquid crystals
summary: We investigate the incompressible hydrodynamic system of the active nematic liquid crystals in the Beris-Edwards framework. Although we focus on constant activity in this paper, the simplified system derived from it exhibits the potential to perform computations and transmit information in active soft materials \cite{defect-active}.
